policies.text: The fictional Standard Current Account has no monthly maintenance fee.

question.en: What is the monthly account fee?

policies.text: Replacing a lost debit card costs NOK 120.

answer.en: Replacing a lost card costs NOK 120.
answer.no: Erstatning av mistet kort koster 120 kroner.
answer.ar: تكلفة استبدال البطاقة المفقودة 120 كرونة نرويجية.

question.en: What does a replacement debit card cost?

policies.text: Customers can freeze and unfreeze debit cards at any time in the mobile app.

answer.en: Freeze or unfreeze the card at any time in the mobile app.
answer.no: Sperr eller åpne kortet når som helst i mobilappen.
answer.ar: يمكن تجميد البطاقة أو إلغاء تجميدها في التطبيق في أي وقت.

question.en: How can I freeze my debit card?

policies.text: Domestic transfers submitted by 14:00 CET on business days are processed on the same business day.

answer.en: The same-day cutoff is 14:00 CET on business days.
answer.no: Fristen for behandling samme virkedag er kl. 14.00 CET.
answer.ar: الموعد النهائي للتحويل في نفس يوم العمل هو 14:00 بتوقيت وسط أوروبا.

question.en: When is the same-day transfer cutoff?
question.no: Når er fristen for overføring samme dag?
question.ar: ما موعد التحويل في نفس يوم العمل؟

policies.text: Disputed card transactions must be reported within 60 calendar days after posting.

answer.en: Report a card dispute within 60 calendar days of posting.
answer.no: Meld korttvisten innen 60 kalenderdager etter bokføring.
answer.ar: يجب الإبلاغ عن النزاع خلال 60 يومًا تقويميًا من تسجيل العملية.

question.en: How long do I have to dispute a card transaction?
question.no: Hva er fristen for å bestride en korttransaksjon?
question.ar: ما مهلة الاعتراض على معاملة البطاقة؟

policies.text: Printed monthly statements cost NOK 35 each; digital statements are free.

answer.en: Paper statements cost NOK 35 and digital statements are free.
answer.no: Papirutskrift koster 35 kroner, mens digital utskrift er gratis.
answer.ar: الكشف الورقي يكلف 35 كرونة والكشف الرقمي مجاني.

question.en: What is the paper statement fee?
question.no: Hva er gebyret for kontoutskrift på papir?

policies.text: Closing an account is free if no unpaid charges remain.

answer.en: Account closure is free if there are no unpaid charges.
answer.no: Det er gratis å avslutte kontoen uten ubetalte gebyrer.
answer.ar: إغلاق الحساب مجاني إذا لم توجد رسوم غير مدفوعة.

question.en: Is there a charge to close my account?

policies.text: Outgoing transfers exceeding NOK 50,000 require manual review before processing.

answer.en: Outgoing transfers above NOK 50,000 require review.
answer.no: Utgående overføringer over 50 000 kroner må kontrolleres manuelt.
answer.ar: تتطلب التحويلات الصادرة فوق 50,000 كرونة مراجعة يدوية.

question.en: What transfer amount requires manual review?
question.ar: ما المبلغ الذي يستلزم مراجعة التحويل؟

policies.text: Student accounts are available to students aged 18 through 25 with proof of enrollment.

answer.en: Students aged 18–25 with enrollment proof qualify.
answer.no: Studenter mellom 18 og 25 år med studiebevis kan søke.
answer.ar: يتأهل الطلاب بين 18 و25 عامًا مع إثبات القيد.

question.en: Who is eligible for a student account?
question.ar: من يحق له فتح حساب طالب؟

policies.text: Human support runs Monday–Friday 09:00–16:00 CET, excluding public holidays.

answer.en: Human support runs Monday–Friday 09:00–16:00 CET, excluding holidays.
answer.no: Kundeservice er åpen mandag–fredag kl. 09–16 CET utenom helligdager.
answer.ar: الدعم متاح من الاثنين إلى الجمعة 09:00–16:00 ما عدا العطل.

question.en: What are the customer support hours?

policies.text: An international transfer carries a flat NOK 75 fee, excluding intermediary bank charges.

answer.en: International transfers cost NOK 75, excluding intermediary charges.
answer.no: Utenlandsoverføring koster 75 kroner uten eventuelle mellomleddgebyrer.
answer.ar: تكلفة التحويل الدولي 75 كرونة دون رسوم البنوك الوسيطة.

question.en: What is the international transfer fee?

policies.text: Daily combined debit-card ATM cash withdrawal limit is NOK 5,000.

answer.en: The daily ATM withdrawal limit is NOK 5,000.
answer.ar: الحد اليومي للسحب من الصراف الآلي هو 5,000 كرونة.

question.en: What is the daily ATM withdrawal limit?

policies.text: A verified customer may hold no more than two active virtual debit cards.

answer.en: Verified customers may hold up to two active virtual cards.
answer.no: Verifiserte kunder kan ha opptil to aktive virtuelle kort.
answer.ar: يمكن للعملاء الموثقين امتلاك بطاقتين افتراضيتين نشطتين كحد أقصى.

question.en: How many virtual cards can a verified customer have?
question.no: Hvor mange aktive virtuelle kort er tillatt?
question.ar: كم بطاقة افتراضية نشطة يُسمح بها؟

policies.text: Mailing address changes require a one-time in-app code and take up to two business days.

answer.en: Confirm by one-time app code; processing takes two business days.
answer.no: Bekreft med engangskode i appen; endringen tar to virkedager.
answer.ar: أكّد برمز لمرة واحدة في التطبيق؛ المعالجة تستغرق يومي عمل.

question.en: How do I change my mailing address and how long will it take?
question.no: Hvordan endrer jeg postadressen, og hvor lang tid tar det?
question.ar: كيف أغير العنوان البريدي وكم يستغرق؟

policies.text: Flex Savings allows three free withdrawals per calendar month; later withdrawals cost NOK 25 each.

answer.en: Three withdrawals are free each month; later ones cost NOK 25.
answer.no: Tre uttak er gratis per måned, deretter koster hvert uttak 25 kroner.
answer.ar: ثلاث سحوبات مجانية شهريًا، وكل سحب إضافي يكلف 25 كرونة.

question.en: What is the free withdrawal allowance for Flex Savings?
question.no: Hvor mange gratis uttak er inkludert i Flex-sparekontoen?
question.ar: كم عملية سحب مجانية متاحة في حساب التوفير؟

policies.text: Physical debit cards require a first chip-and-PIN purchase before contactless payments work.

answer.en: Activate with a chip-and-PIN purchase before contactless use.
answer.no: Aktiver med chip og PIN før kontaktløs betaling.
answer.ar: فعّل البطاقة بشراء بالشريحة والرقم السري قبل الدفع اللاتلامسي.

question.en: How do I activate contactless on a new physical debit card?
question.no: Hvordan aktiverer jeg kontaktløs betaling på nytt kort?
question.ar: كيف أفعّل الدفع اللاتلامسي للبطاقة الجديدة؟

policies.text: Scheduled domestic payments can be cancelled until 18:00 CET on the preceding business day; later cancellation is not guaranteed.

answer.en: Cancel before 18:00 CET the preceding business day.
answer.no: Avbestill før kl. 18 CET foregående virkedag.
answer.ar: ألغِ قبل الساعة 18:00 من يوم العمل السابق.

question.en: When can I cancel a scheduled domestic transfer?
question.no: Når kan jeg kansellere en planlagt innenlandsbetaling?
question.ar: متى يمكن إلغاء تحويل محلي مجدول؟

policies.text: New international beneficiaries become eligible for outgoing payment 24 hours after addition.

answer.en: Wait 24 hours after adding a new international beneficiary.
answer.no: Vent 24 timer etter at ny utenlandsmottaker er lagt til.
answer.ar: انتظر 24 ساعة بعد إضافة مستفيد دولي جديد.

question.en: How soon may I pay a newly added international beneficiary?
question.no: Hvor raskt kan jeg betale en ny utenlandsmottaker?
question.ar: متى يمكن الدفع لمستفيد دولي أضيف للتو؟

en: What is the overdraft interest rate?
Does this bank guarantee investment returns?
no: Hva er gebyret for uttak i utenlandsk minibank?
